question: Should maintainers accept this ownership split after confirming that the wrapped and adapter paths preserve the existing approval ordering, finalizer receiver semantics, and prepared-parameter identity contract?
rationale: This is a maintainer-labeled refactor of a security-sensitive control boundary; source-level checks alone cannot choose the acceptable risk level for preserving historical execution semantics.

options.title: Review and retain the split
options.body: Verify the two execution paths against their established policy and finalization invariants, then merge once live proof is attached.

options.title: Narrow the refactor
options.body: Keep only independently reviewable module moves if the current combined policy-and-execution change remains too difficult to audit safely.

recommendation.title: Review and retain the split
recommendation.body: Verify the two execution paths against their established policy and finalization invariants, then merge once live proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence identifies direct current involvement with the exact policy and execution boundary being reorganized.
